notes: Two sayings in one report (rule 11): the Jibril prayer-time saying, which Urwa reports from Bashir from his father; and Urwa's own «ولقد حدثتني عائشة» (the Asr timing), with its own isnad from Aisha. Both are written as groups; the ruling decides how they are split.
«قرأت على مالك عن ابن شهاب»: Malik and Ibn Shihab are links; the Umar anecdote (Urwa's «أخبره», Abu Mas'ud's words, Umar's reply) is scene, not transmission.
«أبيه» is Bashir's father, named only by relation; he is not completed.
